ladders.name: Generosity
ladders.line: You shared without counting. Up you go.

ladders.name: Truth
ladders.line: You said the honest thing, even though it was hard.

ladders.name: Gratitude
ladders.line: You said thank you and meant it. The path opens.

ladders.name: Patience
ladders.line: You waited calmly, and time carried you forward.

ladders.name: Service
ladders.line: You helped with no reward in mind. Karma took note.

ladders.name: Courage
ladders.line: You did the scary thing anyway.

ladders.name: Knowledge
ladders.line: You learned something true, and the fog lifted.

ladders.name: Self-control
ladders.line: You wanted to react, and you chose not to.

ladders.name: Devotion
ladders.line: You gave it your whole heart. A shortcut to the top.

snakes.name: Gossip
snakes.line: A little loose talk, and down you slide.

snakes.name: Lies
snakes.line: A small lie needed a bigger one to hold it up.

snakes.name: Envy
snakes.line: You watched someone else's plate and dropped your own.

snakes.name: Attachment
snakes.line: You held on too tight, and it pulled you back.

snakes.name: Greed
snakes.line: Enough was not enough. The snake agrees.

snakes.name: Anger
snakes.line: One hot moment, a long slide down.

snakes.name: Lust for power
snakes.line: You climbed over others, and the ground gave way.

snakes.name: Pride
snakes.line: So close to the top that you forgot to look down.

snakes.name: Ego
snakes.line: The longest snake of all waits right by the finish. Stay humble.

luck.line: Vipat Tara: slow and steady wins today
Vadha Tara: keep it simple and kind today
